title: Backport SL Migration - Snapshot Project Transactions
summary: Support for snapshotting and migrating historical Dynamics SL project transactions is added to the SL historical data app, including new tables, viewing pages, and configuration options.
key_points: New HybridSL source tables for PJTran and PJTranEx, plus historical tables for PJTran, PJTranEx, PJProj and PJEmploy
New pages for historical batch entries and project transaction entries, reachable from Job List and Job Card extensions
New Migrate Hist. Project Trans. setting and population logic, but the procedure is not yet called by the orchestrator and the setting is not on the configuration pages
Hybrid Wizard adds PJTran/PJTranEx replication mappings, and a new migration step type is added with reset cleanup
PJTran/PJTranEx entries added to 10 permission sets
quote: Adds support for snapshotting/migrating historical Dynamics SL project transactions into the SL historical data app, with a new configuration toggle and viewing pages.
